title: Fairy Tale
author: Stephen King
summary: Seventeen-year-old Charlie Reade befriends a reclusive old man and his loyal dog, then finds that the locked shed behind the man's house hides a way into another world. What waits there is part fairy story, part war.
readIf: you like Stephen King in a more adventurous, kid-hero mode, with a portal world and a strong bond between a boy and a dog.
skipIf: you want King at his most frightening, since this leans toward dark fantasy and the first stretch is slow and character-led.

pairings.reason: Also a dark fairy story seen through a young narrator, but much shorter and more dreamlike.
A classic about slipping out of the ordinary world into a vast, imperilled fantasy land, with a gentler touch.
Another King novel built around a resourceful young hero up against a hidden, ruthless power.
